articles.title: Wall Street trotsade orosmolnen och steg
articles.summary: Nyheter från TV4: Wall Street trotsade orosmolnen och steg
articles.body_text: Wall Street trotsade orosmolnen och steg New York-börsen trotsade de mörka molnen, valde solen och steg på måndagen. Främst var det de stora teknikbolagen som agerade draglok. Orosmoln i form av skenande statsskuld, inflation samt fortsatt stigande statsobligationsräntor och oljepriser. Ändå steg Dow Jones industriindex 0,2 procent, breda S&P 500-index 0,7 och tekniktunga Nasdaqs kompositindex 1,1 procent. Börsen fick hjälp av att fem av de indextunga teknikbolag som tillsammans kallas ”de magnifika sju” – alla på listan över världens elva högst värderade börsbolag – steg. Av de sju backade bara Amazon och Apple. Kurserna upprätthålls av bland annat starka företagsresultat, konsumtionen och enorma AI-kopplade investeringar. Det som är uppmuntrande är att styrkan inte är en tillfällighet. Vi ser en sund kombination av tillväxt och ökade marginaler, säger Mark Hackett, chefsstrateg på analysfirman Nationwide.

articles.title: Arla lägger ned Falbygdens ost
articles.summary: Nyheter från TV4: Arla lägger ned Falbygdens ost
articles.body_text: Falbygdens ost läggs ned av Arla. Arkivbild. Falbygdens ost i Falköping läggs ned av Arla, som äger företaget. Totalt kommer omkring 60 tjänster att försvinna, skriver Arla i ett pressmeddelande. Verksamheten har länge dragits med dålig lönsamhet, enligt Arla, som köpte Falbygdens ost av finska Atria 2014. Företaget bedriver ingen egen osttillverkning och använder inte mjölk från Arlabönder utan bygger sin verksamhet på import, lagring, förädling och paketering av special- och dessertostar. ”Det är ett tungt besked både för våra medarbetare och för lokalsamhället i Falköping. Vi har stor respekt för Falbygdens osts långa historia och för de människor som berörs av beslutet”, säger Anna Schreil, chef för Arlas logistik och produktion. Några av dessertostarna förs över till varumärket Castello. De lagrade svenska ostklassikerna lever vidare under varumärket Kvibille.

articles.title: Kvargboomen får mejerierna att investera hundratals miljoner
articles.summary: Tror att trenden kommit för att stanna
articles.body_text: Kvargboomen får mejerierna att investera hundratals miljoner Efterfrågan på kvarg har ökat kraftigt de senaste åren. Nu investerar svenska mejerier närmare en halv miljard kronor för att kunna möta den växande efterfrågan. På gymmet i Umeå är kvarg en del av kosten för flera av dem som tränar regelbundet. – Jag äter extra protein både för att jag tränar och för att man behöver extra protein när man blir äldre, säger Linda Vidström Lundmark. Försäljningen av kvarg har skjutit i höjden de senaste åren. Mellan september 2025 och september 2026 ökade försäljningen med 28 procent, enligt analysföretaget Nielsen IQ. – Den har ju gått från stark till nästan kaotisk den senaste perioden. Vi har helt klart märkt hur den har slagit i taket, säger Johan Westerlund, affärsutvecklare på Norrmejerier i Umeå. Den ökade efterfrågan märks nu också i mejeriernas investeringar. Arla Foods satsar 380 miljoner kronor på ökad kvargproduktion och ytterligare 310 miljoner på att tillverka mer keso. Skånemejerier investerar 70 miljoner kronor i kvargproduktion. Och på Norrmejerier i Umeå satsas 50 miljoner kronor på en ny metod som ska göra det möjligt att öka kvargproduktionen i den befintliga anläggningen. Allt är inte klart men i nya rör flyter proteinet – den viktiga beståndsdelen i kvarg. Den växande efterfrågan drivs bland annat av intresset för protein och produkter med lågt fettinnehåll. Kvarg har blivit populärt bland personer som tränar, personer som använder viktminskningsläkemedel och äldre som vill bevara muskelmassa. Men behöver unga som tränar verkligen äta stora mängder kvarg för att få i sig tillräckligt med protein? – De flesta som tränar täcker sitt proteinbehov med den vanliga maten. Man behöver inte äta extra kvarg av den anledningen, säger David Jonsson, universitetsadjunkt på institutionen för kost- och måltidsvetenskap vid Umeå universitet. Samtidigt kan kvarg vara ett enkelt sätt att få i sig mer protein för den som faktiskt har ett högre behov.

articles.title: Utlyser nyval i Spanien efter bostadskrisen
articles.summary: Nyheter från TV4: Utlyser nyval i Spanien efter bostadskrisen
articles.body_text: Utlyser nyval i Spanien efter bostadskrisen Spaniens premiärminister Pedro Sánchez utlyser nyval sedan hans regering inte fått igenom sina förslag om nya åtgärder för att lösa landets bostadskris. Nyvalet ska hållas den 29 november. Beslutet att utlysa nyval meddelas under ett tv-sänt tal på måndagsmorgonen. Bostadspaketet, i huvudsak bestående av två olika lagar, lades fram efter det att en 87-årig kvinna vräktes från sin lägenhet i Madrid – vilket har fått spanjorernas ilska över bostadskrisen att kulminera. Förslagen syftade till att fram till år 2030 stoppa vräkningar av utsatta personer, göra det svårare att spekulera i fastigheter, att försvåra korttidsuthyrningar ytterligare, samt att hyreskontrakt förlängs automatiskt.

articles.body_text: Hur fungerar den publicistiska grunden för nyhets- och samhällsjournalistik på TV4? 9 januari 2024 ・ Uppdaterad: 15 augusti 2025 TV4:s nyhets- och samhällsbevakning ska vara i ögonhöjd med tittarna. Vi vill vara nära, personliga och inkluderande. För alla i hela Sverige. Vi ska vara trovärdiga och relevanta. Vi testar nya visuella former och utvecklar det rörliga berättandet. Vi är både snabba, och fördjupande. Vi ger plats för både humor och allvar. Vi påverkar och berör. Vi avslöjar maktmissbruk, och värnar pressfrihet och yttrandefrihet. Vi producerar Nyhetsmorgon, Nyhetsdagen, Efter fem och kvällsnyheter. Vi nyhetsrapporterar på tv4.se och fördjupar i kortdokumentärerna Nyheterna Story. Vår mångfaldigt prisbelönta redaktion Kalla Fakta granskar makt och missförhållanden. TV4:s nyhets- och samhällsbevakning sker ur ett riksperspektiv, med hela Sverige och världen som bevakningsområde. Vi har 17 rikskorrar på sex orter i Sverige. De finns i Luleå, Umeå, Östersund, Skövde, Göteborg och Malmö. Vi bevakar världen via utrikesreportrar, korrar och stringers. Vår journalistik vilar på respekt för alla människors lika värde, oavsett politisk åskådning, religion eller sexuell läggning. Det innebär att vi låter många röster komma till tals, även de som bär åsikter som inte nödvändigtvis delas av medarbetarna på redaktionen eller TV4. Men det kan också innebära att vi tar bort artikelkommentarer som kränker, eller till exempel avstår gäster i direktsändning där vi bedömer att risken är stor för missbruk av öppenheten. TV4:s nyhets- och samhällsjournalistik är oberoende och obunden. Den står fri från politiska partier, organisationer, och näringsliv. Vi har ingen ledarsida eller politisk färg. Innehållet på våra plattformar bedöms och värderas av redaktörer, producenter och av ansvarig utgivare före publicering. Vi följer grundlagen och skyddar våra källor när de önskar anonymitet. Om vi refererar uppgifter från andra medier redovisar vi vilka medier eller andra informationskällor det handlar om. Annars berättar vi hur vi själva tagit reda på informationen, dock alltid med största respekt för källskydd.

articles.title: Kulturnyheterna special: Avgörs valet på TikTok?
articles.summary: För första gången finns alla partiledare på Tiktok, samtidigt som nästan hälften av alla förstagångsväljare säger att de oftare tar del av politik på sociala medier än i tidningar, radio och tv. Vad gör det här med politiken, och är det på en kinesisk plattform som framställs som en säkerhetsrisk som det svenska valet kommer att avgöras? Medverkande: Emanuel Karlsten, journalist, Kajsa Falasca, forskare, och Oscar Samuelsson, kommunikationsrådgivare. Programledare: Cecilia Tiberg.

articles.title: Paasikivi vid fronten
articles.summary: Joakim Paasikivi lämnar tryggheten i tv-studion för att själv uppleva krigets verklighet i Ukraina. I Charkiv - staden som dagligen bombas av ryska styrkor - ställs hans analys på prov när han möter kriget på nära håll. Där träffar han ukrainska drönarsoldater som spelar en avgörande roll i motståndet. Hur påverkas hans analys när han själv känner tryckvågen från explosionerna?

articles.title: SVT Sport möter Graham Potter
articles.summary: I oktober 2025 tog engelsmannen Graham Potter över som förbundskapten för det svenska herrlandslaget i fotboll - efter att hans föregångare Jon Dahl Tomasson misslyckats med att ta Sverige direkt till fotbolls-VM. 50-årige Potter har ett förflutet som tränare för Premier League-klubbarna Brighton och Chelsea. Men för den svenska publiken är han kanske främst förknippad med sitt tränarjobb i Östersunds FK, som han tog från division 2 ända upp till allsvenskan. Så hur ska då Graham Potter vända den negativa trend som herrlandslaget befinner sig i? Har han vad som krävs för att Sverige ska ta sig till VM i sommar? Det och mycket annat frågade SVT Sports programledare André Pops honom.

articles.title: Bortglömda fiskar
articles.summary: Teatrar och konserthus lockar allt oftare med olika sidoevenemang. Teater Västernorrland har musikquiz, Folkoperan sänder poddar från sin foajé och på Göteborgsoperan kan man höra föredrag eller vara med och dansa. De uppsluppna tillställningarna, före och efter konserter och föreställningar, lockar också en ny sorts publik. En av Östersjöfestivalens mest omtalade programpunkter, förutom musiken i Berwaldhallen, har varit “Bortglömda fiskar” - en oväntad kulinarisk träff med Kålrotsakademin och provsmakning av “svensk sushi”. “Gensvaret från publiken är enormt. Man vill bli överraskad”, konstaterar Emma Nyberg, exekutiv producent på Berwaldhallen. Och på frågan om vad nors och näbbgädda har att göra i ett konserthus kommer det självklara svaret snabbt: “Att äta gott och att lyssna på klassisk musik hör ihop, båda skärper och öppnar våra sinnen.”

articles.title: På ett ögonblick
articles.summary: Arne Bivrins stora passion är fågelfotografi. Han kliver in i en sagovärld och tar bilder som får folk att häpna, av ögonblick som bara existerar där och då. Efter en stor tragedi där hela livet förändrades på några sekunder överlevde han med hjälp av fotografin. Under ett år följer vi Arne när han tar sig an sitt livs största fotoprojekt. Naturfilm producerad av Emil Sergel.

articles.title: France braces for national day of student protests after injuries and mass arrests
articles.summary: France prepares for a day of protests in support of students who’ve been demanding more investment in education.
articles.body_text: France is braced for major protests on Tuesday, after organisers called for a nationwide day of action in support of students demanding more investment in education. It comes after a week of demonstrations, which saw students blockading hundreds of schools, at least 190 students injured, and more than 5,000 people arrested. One student had his hand blown off during a confrontation on Monday, while another was reportedly struck in the head by a tear gas grenade last week. France's prime minister said the government had announced measures to address their demands, but the Union Syndicale Lycéenne (USL), a major organiser of the protests, said the government had offered "nothing concrete". The organisation called on people to join their mobilisation on Tuesday in the face of "this political deadlock and what we describe as unprecedented repression of the movement". Some other organisations have also shown their support for the students, with the teachers' union SNES-FSU urging its members to join Tuesday's protest. The radical-left La France Insoumise (LFI) party leader Jean-Luc Mélenchon described the protests as the "most powerful high school and university student youth movement" since 1968 - a year of major unrest, which saw millions of workers go on strike. The wave of demonstrations began in September in Paris and has spread across the country, with students protesting over a range of issues, including overcrowded classrooms, run-down buildings, and a lack of teachers. The protests were started by high school students, who were later joined by university students. On Sunday, French Prime Minister Sébastien Lecornu announced a series of measures to "address the difficulties faced by secondary school students and education staff", promising "visible changes" in schools. However, he also said: "We will make no concessions to violence. We stand by students and staff who have been assaulted, as well as police officers and gendarmes who have been injured." The unrest has not only seen schools blockaded, but also rubbish bins set on fire. Education Minister Édouard Geffray said 24 schools had been "burned and ransacked" since the start of the protests.

articles.title: Donald Trump says a 'threat' led US to move bombers from RAF Fairford
articles.summary: The Pentagon confirmed on Sunday it had removed the B1 bombers from the base in England back to their home stations in America.
articles.body_text: President Donald Trump has said the US moved its bombers out of RAF Fairford because of "some threats" to the base. The Pentagon confirmed on Sunday it had removed its bombers - thought to be about a dozen B-1s - from the base back to their home stations in America. Speaking to reporters as he departed for Nebraska on Monday, Trump said the US had known of a "threat", which led them to move the bombers. Earlier on Monday, a No 10 spokesperson had insisted RAF Fairford was safe and pointed to Trump's comments last week, where he praised the UK's "police, defence and security services" in relation to the base. Trump's comments appear to confirm reports by US media that a new threat led to the bombers being removed after a major incident on 27 September when police were alerted to three "suspicious vehicles" near the airbase. While speaking to a gaggle of reporters outside the White House, Trump was asked if a "specific threat" had led the US to pull its bombers from the airbase. Trump replied: "Yeah I think we can say that. They didn't fly out by accident. "There were some threats. And rather than tempting the enemy, we'll capture the enemy and beat the enemy. But why should we leave them there? So we moved them around a little bit. Not very far." He added Washington "actually knows the people that made the threat", but he did not confirm who. The exact nature of the threat that prompted the aircraft's removal from RAF Fairford remains unclear, but sources in Washington speculated to the BBC it might have revolved around sabotage attempts or attempts to strike the sensitive, expensive aircraft in the event of resumed hostilities with Iran. One source close to the White House pointed to Ukraine's Operation Spiderweb - a covert drone attack on five Russian bases in June last year - as an example of what an enemy force could do, even at a distance. "Whatever they thought it was, it was taken extremely seriously," the source said.

articles.title: US 'watching closely' after plague researcher dies in Russia
articles.summary: Donald Trump says the US was looking "very strongly" at the case of a lab technician who died at a research centre in Siberia.
articles.body_text: President Donald Trump says the US is looking "very strongly" at the case of a Russian lab technician who died at a plague research centre in Siberia. Secretary of State Marco Rubio said Washington was watching closely amid concerns the incident could lead to the spread of pneumonic plague, but there was no cause for alarm. Announcing the cause of death as "pneumonia of undetermined etiology", Irkutsk's governor said "no micro-organisms" linked to the woman's work had been found "in her biological samples". Unconfirmed reports suggested the woman fell ill either after breaking a test tube containing the pathogen or following a field trip to a region where plague occurs naturally among wild rodents. Asked what Washington was going to do about the risk of plague spreading from Russia, Trump said he had not spoken to the Kremlin about it. "I hate to see them having it," he said, but added: "We'll help. Everybody who has that kind of a problem, we'll always help." No other cases of staff from the plague institute seeking medical attention since the lab technician's death had been reported, Irkutsk governor Igor Kobzev said, quoting Russia's consumer and health watchdog, Rospotrebnadzor. The watchdog said a biological safety team had inspected the Anti-Plague Institute of Siberia and the Far East in Irkutsk and found no emergency situation there. Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov urged people not to "listen to various rumours" but "rely on Rospotrebnadzor's official statements" instead. Russian media reported last week that nearly 200 people known to have had contact with the dead woman were under medical observation as a precaution. Asked by a reporter for an "update on the suspected plague case in Russia", Secretary of State Marco Rubio said: "It seems that there was a worker at the lab that was infected and there's concern that that, you know, could have spread, at least internally - you've seen them do quarantine of this and that nature. "If something like that gets out, it can quickly spread. So we're watching and monitoring it closely. I don't think it's cause for alarm, but it is cause for focus and the cause to just keep an eye on it and we're doing that."

articles.title: Spain PM pins hopes on housing crisis to help win snap election
articles.summary: Calling of a snap election was not a knee-jerk reaction from Pedro Sánchez but a carefully thought-out manoeuvre, Guy Hedgecoe reports from Madrid.
articles.body_text: Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez's decision to call a snap election for 29 November came on the back of a parliamentary defeat. On Friday, the raft of measures he had presented to congress aimed at improving conditions for tenants and trying to address the problem of soaring rentals was narrowly rejected, as parties on the right voted against them. That parliamentary result confirmed that Sánchez's left-wing coalition no longer commanded a majority. But as has so often been the case throughout Sánchez's career, the calling of the election was not a knee-jerk reaction but a carefully thought-out manouevre. His government has been struggling in recent months. His Socialist Party has been mired in corruption, with cases implicating former senior figures in the party, Santos Cerdán and José Luis Ábalos, while the former Socialist Prime Minister, José Luis Rodríguez Zapatero, is facing accusations of having benefited financially from the government's bailout of an airline. Zapatero has denied wrongdoing. In addition, Sánchez's wife, Begoña Gómez, is due to go on trial over allegations of misuse of funds and influence peddling - accusations that Gómez and Sánchez vehemently deny. Meanwhile, Sánchez's administration has struggled to manage the crisis in the Spanish exclave of Ceuta in North Africa, where more than 70,000 migrants suddenly arrived in July. Most have returned over the border to Morocco, but the city has become a political and logistical headache for the prime minister. Although Sánchez had insisted until recently that he would see out the legislature and not call elections until next summer, his government had looked increasingly unlikely to make it that far. The wave of outrage which has exploded in recent days over housing has provided him with the ideal reason to call elections early - and a welcome issue away from Ceuta and the allegations of corruption. Appealing to his own party's voters and those further to the left on Monday, he called for voters to "mobilise and ensure that parliament gives us a much bigger, progressive majority with which to defeat the elites, conquer social rights and keep transforming Spain". On the upcoming campaign trail, Sánchez can point to the fact that his adversaries on the right - such as the conservative People's Party (PP) and the far-right Vox - voted against his government's housing measures, which sought to prevent the eviction of tenants, improving the conditions of their contracts and preventing investors from buying residential property.

articles.title: Pentagon stops using Anthropic tools after blacklisting company, BBC told
articles.summary: It labelled Anthropic a "supply chain risk" in February after the firm refused to remove safety guardrails from its tools.
articles.body_text: The US Department of Defence is no longer using Anthropic's AI tools, an official has told the BBC, months after it designated the company a supply chain risk on national security grounds. The Pentagon "has ceased the use of Anthropic products", the department official said in a statement on Monday. Secretary of Defence Pete Hegseth labelled Anthropic a supply chain risk in February, and announced that the Pentagon would stop using it by late August. It is not clear why there has been a delay. Multiple people familiar with the matter told the BBC that as recently as last week Anthopic's Claude model was still being used by the department in research, analysis and intelligence gathering as well as in military operations against Iran. It was viewed as a critical tool for sorting through vast quantities of information, the people said. They include former US defence officials and contractors who have worked closely with the Pentagon specifically on AI. A spokesman for Anthropic declined to comment when asked about the Pentagon's statement. The details of the department stopping all use of Anthropic's tools have not been previously reported. The firm had been used by the US government and military since 2024 and was the first advanced AI company to have its tools deployed in government agencies doing classified work. But earlier this year, the Pentagon pressed it to remove its safety guardrails from Claude and give the military unfettered access to its AI products. When Anthropic refused, citing concerns of mass surveillance and autonomous weapons, Hegseth designated the company a "national security supply-chain risk" - a law typically reserved for companies based in countries that pose a threat to the US. Anthropic said the move was "unprecedented and unlawful" and has sued the Trump administration in an effort to overturn the designation. As this legal fight has played out in the courts, the Pentagon has signed contracts with other major tech companies, including Google, xAI and OpenAI.

articles.title: Zelensky condemns 'horrific' Russian strike on boat carrying corn in Black Sea
articles.summary: The vessel's captain was killed and 11 crew members were rescued after the attack on the Turkish-owned ship, Ukraine's leader says.
articles.body_text: Ukraine's President Volodymyr Zelensky has condemned a "horrific" Russian attack on a vessel carrying corn in the Black Sea. The ship's captain was killed in the strike involving two drones, Zelensky said, and another sailor was unaccounted for. Eleven crew members - nationals of Azerbaijan and India - have been rescued. Romania said it had mounted a rescue mission after "a fire on the ship Royad Mammadov" outside the country's territorial waters. It said two people had died. Russia has not commented, but its defence ministry earlier said it had struck two cargo vessels. Russia has been pounding Ukrainian infrastructure in what it says is retaliation for Ukrainian attacks on Russian oil refineries and ships in the Black Sea. Monday's attack by Russia targeted "a civilian vessel in neutral waters carrying corn and owned by Turkey", Volodymyr Zelensky said. He did not give the location of the ship, but Romania's interior ministry said it had sunk about 30 nautical miles south of its port of Sfantu Gheorghe. "At around 11:00 (09:00 GMT), Coast Guard border police officers were informed that a fire had broken out on board a commercial vessel located within Romania's exclusive economic zone," the ministry said in a statement. "Eleven crew members have been rescued. Two deceased persons have also been identified," it added. Ukraine's president said he had "repeatedly proposed concrete steps to de-escalate the situation and ensure security in the Black Sea" - and other countries had made "relevant proposals" too. "But Russia consistently chooses terror and sinking civilian vessels instead of normal maritime navigation," Zelensky said. "Pressure is needed to restore global food security," he added. "And everyone who is genuinely interested in this must help." On Sunday, Russia's defence ministry said it would intensify its strikes across Ukraine in response to comments made by Zelensky earlier last week, in which he said Kyiv would ramp up its attacks on Russian oil refineries.

articles.title: Nigeria NYSC abductions: Bombs preventing rescue of kidnapped youths, Imo police say
articles.summary: The father of one of the 19 young abductees tells the BBC he hasn't eaten in three days out of worry.
articles.body_text: Nigerian police say they have located a camp where 19 national youth service recruits are being held by gunmen but cannot move in as they believe the place is mined with explosives. Police Commissioner Audu Bosso said drones helped locate the camp where the prospective National Youth Service Corps (NYSC) members were taken after being abducted last week in the south-eastern Imo state. The exact location of the camp has not been disclosed and police have not identified those responsible for the kidnapping. Omotosho Adewale, whose child is among those abducted, told the BBC that the kidnappers had demanded a ransom of 50m naira ($37,680; £28,440), which he could not afford. "There's no peace of mind. I've not eaten in three days," he said in between tears. Adewale appealed to the government for help. Those kidnapped had been travelling from Ibadan in the south-west to NYSC orientation camps in Abia and Akwa Ibom states on Thursday when gunmen attacked their buses near Umunoha in Imo state. The NYSC is a compulsory one-year programme for most Nigerian university and polytechnic graduates. Participants, known as corps members, are posted to different parts of the country to work and take part in community service, as well as to foster a sense of national unity. Speaking to journalists, Bosso said they had tracked the kidnappers. "The drone actually showed us exactly their location. But our predicament is that with the intel we have... the camp is mined with IEDs [homemade bombs]," he said. Bulldozers and armoured vehicles are being deployed as police prepare for a rescue operation. Kidnapping for ransom is a major security problem in Nigeria, involving both criminal gangs and armed groups.

articles.title: Georgia officials hunt for suspect in shooting that killed two and injured 35
articles.summary: A homecoming celebration turned into a scene of deadly violence, as dozens of shots were fired into a crowd.
articles.body_text: Investigators in the US state of Georgia are on the hunt for a suspect in a mass shooting that erupted in the early hours of Sunday, killing two people and injuring 35 more. A crowd of roughly 1,000 people had gathered for a block party in the southern rural community of Vienna when, according to officials, more than 50 shots were fired. Two of the victims were pronounced dead at the scene, while another 25 were transported to multiple nearby hospitals, some in critical condition. No known arrests have been made and authorities have not given a possible motive for the violence. Victims ranged in age from 14 to 51. The incident occurred on Sunday morning around 01:30 local time (05:30 GMT), during a Dooly High School homecoming celebration, though it was not a school-sponsored event. "Our hearts are with the families grieving the loss of loved ones, those who were injured, and everyone affected by this tragedy," the school said in a statement. Anticipating a large gathering, authorities from the Dooly County Sheriff's Office were already positioned at both ends of the crowd as gunfire rang out. "Some people were reporting fireworks and then someone said somebody been shot," Dooly County Sheriff Craig Peavy told local media. Peavy said officials then worked their way through the crowd, as people ran scrambling in different directions, while authorities made their way towards victims. Ashley Gee, who was there, told the Atlanta Journal-Constitution news outlet that the barrage of gunfire sounded "like a machine gun". Authorities arrived and found several people injured. The two deceased victims were found several blocks away from the scene of the shooting on Pine Street. Dooly County Coroner Brett Walls told the BBC's US media partner, CBS News, the two killed were both men, ages 20 and 23.

articles.title: Flydubai co-pilot planned to crash plane into airport, reports suggest
articles.summary: The Omani national was a "lone wolf" extremist, according to the reports.
articles.body_text: The co-pilot accused of trying to hijack a flydubai plane planned to crash the aircraft into Tel Aviv's Ben Gurion airport or a tower block in the Israeli city, US and Israeli reports suggest. The Omani national was a "lone wolf" extremist, according to the reports. The United Arab Emirates' attorney-general has said the co-pilot attempted to carry out a "terrorist act" on flight FZ1073 from Dubai to Tel Aviv last Wednesday. He attacked and wounded the captain with the emergency crash axe kept in the cockpit before being overpowered by passengers. Another crew travelling on the plane was able to land it in Saudi Arabia. Israel's prime minister has said the co-pilot underwent "Islamist radical indoctrination" and the captain, passengers and a second crew prevented "a 9/11 disaster". More details about the co-pilot of the flydubai flight – whom multiple reports have named as Hamam al-Hammami – emerged over the weekend as he continued to be questioned in the UAE, with Israeli representatives being updated. Israeli media cited sources with knowledge of the probe as saying the co-pilot told investigators that, having attacked Capt Smit Machchhar, he intended to continue flying the plane as normal into Israeli airspace and receive landing clearances from Ben Gurion airport. He then planned to crash the Boeing 737 MAX – with more than 180 passengers on board – into the airport or into a tower block in central Tel Aviv, in the style of al-Qaeda's 11 September 2001 attacks in the US, according to the reports. The sources are quoted as saying he was most likely to have acted alone rather than on behalf of a radical organisation or foreign government. The co-pilot also reportedly told investigators that he had intended to hijack and crash a previous flight to Tel Aviv but changed his mind because he knew someone on board. There was no immediate comment from Emirati or Israeli authorities. UAE Attorney-General Hamad al-Shamsi said on Saturday that his country's investigations would establish the full circumstances, motives and any links related to the incident, and that the results would be announced upon their conclusion.

articles.title: Anuv Jain: Rising Indian singer on new music and future hopes
articles.summary: The star reveals why he is "very selective" about releasing music - and shares his future collab hopes.
articles.body_text: Can you find success as an Indian artist, outside of the Bollywood machine, while making music that feels like you? Well according to Anuv Jain it's possible - and you can even create something "beautiful". The singer-songwriter's soft vocals have gained hundreds of millions of views on YouTube - not an easy feat as an independent artist in India's music scene. BBC Newsbeat met Jain as he prepared for the final shows on the European leg of his first world tour to find out why he's taking his time and "hoping for the best". "It's not about the numbers," Jain tells us backstage, ahead of his sold-out performance at London's Roundhouse. Jain is from Ludhiana in the Punjab region of India and began singing as a teenager. His tracks have since racked up hundreds of millions of views on YouTube with their emotional storylines about relationships and heartbreak. Jain primarily sings in Hindi, with his pieces often exploring deep emotions like love and longing. Fans talk about feeling like his music soundtracks their lives and is personal to them. His accessible style has attracted 3.9 million followers on Instagram and more than 20 million monthly listeners on Spotify. According to Jain, the secret to his success is simple. When writing music, he says, he imagines how someone listening in the car, going for a run or sitting alone at night would feel hearing the song.

articles.title: Nobel Prize for Medicine for showing inner workings of the brain
articles.summary: US psychiatrist and neurologist Karl Deisseroth and his German colleagues Peter Hegemann and Georg Nagel have been awarded for their work.
articles.body_text: US psychiatrist and neurologist Karl Deisseroth and his German colleagues Peter Hegemann and Georg Nagel have been awarded this year's Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine for their work in the field of optogenetics. Their research has helped scientists learn more about the inner workings of the brain, to better understand how the human mind works. The Nobel Committee praised the trio for laying the foundation of a new era in neuroscience by revealing how to switch on and off neural circuits behind "specific memories, feelings, and behaviours relevant for neurological and psychiatric disorders". In clinical medicine, researchers are using the method to try to restore sight in people with visual impairment . "Optogenetics has fundamentally altered our understanding of the brain," the Nobel Assembly said. "Every day brings new discoveries, helping to solve one of humanity's great mysteries: how our incredible brain works." The winners said it was "absolutely wonderful" to get the award, and that it was an honour to share the accolade with friends. The three men will also share the £900,000 (12 million Swedish kronor) prize money. Per Svenningsson, chair of the Nobel Committee for Physiology or Medicine, explained: "Optogenetics provides opportunities for mapping the brain in a way that we could once only dream of." Before, the inner workings behind feelings, behaviours and bodily functions were more of a mystery to scientists. Optogenetics is a way to illuminate brain pathways, using a special protein borrowed from algae that scientists use to control cell electrical activity using light. In the early 2000s, Hegemann and Nagel discovered channelrhodopsin, the algal protein with unique properties.

articles.title: 'Not again': Arrest of US marine for murder reignites protests in Japan's Okinawa
articles.summary: For many locals on this island, the arrest has brought decades of frustration back to the fore.
articles.body_text: For many Okinawa locals, the arrest of a US soldier accused of robbing and killing a woman in a hotel room has reignited decades of frustration over crimes involving US military personnel there. "Honestly my first reaction was, 'Not again,'" 52-year-old longtime Okinawa resident Ai Sato told the BBC. "Nothing has changed since I was a child. How many times are we going to repeat the same thing, create more victims, cause their families to suffer, and ultimately, cause the people of Okinawa to grieve?" Akemi Oshiro, a 62-year-old Ginowan resident shared similar sentiments. "I know we shouldn't get used to terrible things like this, but because they keep happening, I've stopped being surprised," she told the BBC. Okinawa hosts the largest US military presence in Japan. It is home to several US military bases and tens of thousands of American troops. US Marine Lance Corporal Devin Jacob Ballard, 20, was arrested by Japanese police on Sunday. Police say an investigation is underway and that Ballard is in Japanese custody because the alleged crime was unrelated to official military duties. Whether a US service member is acting in the performance of official duty or not can determine which country has primary jurisdiction. When Japan has jurisdiction, but the suspect is under US custody, they can retain custody until Japan brings charges. Ballard was assigned to III Marine Expeditionary Force and stationed at Marine Corps Air Station Futenma in Ginowan City. The Okinawa prefectural police say 39-year-old Anna Yagi was found dead early 3 October in a hotel room in Naha. Security footage allegedly shows a man believed to be the suspect entering the hotel with the woman and leaving alone with her belongings. Local media citing police have reported that Yagi appeared to have been strangled with a cord. Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi registered an official protest with Washington. But residents like Sato feel that's far from enough.

articles.title: Trade: How India became dangerously addicted to Chinese imports
articles.summary: India’s toy shops provide an unlikely barometer by which to measure its economic relationship with China.
articles.body_text: Take a walk into an Indian toy shop and as well as picking up a new favourite plaything for a child, you might just get an insight into how the nation is battling for a better economic relationship with its all-powerful neighbour China. Six years ago, in an attempt to push local manufacturing and keep substandard toys out of its market, India raised tariffs on imported toys from 20% to 60% and eventually to 70%. Retailers were up in arms and said that domestic firms could never match the foreign-made stuff. But the combination of higher customs duties and quality control standards worked. Indian imports of toys fell by a third from nearly $300m (£227m) in 2020 to $100m this year, while exports rose from around $129m to $200m in the same period. Moreover, the country was able to drastically reduce its dependence on China, which held a 70% share of the local toy market. The sector stands out as a rare exception in India's otherwise unsuccessful attempts to rebalance an increasingly lopsided trading relationship with its larger neighbour, which some experts say, is now among the most asymmetric in the world. Even as diplomatic ties between the two countries completely broke down following the Galwan Valley clashes in 2020 and Delhi announced a slew of anti-dumping duties and a ban on Chinese apps such as Tik Tok, its trade deficit with Beijing has only ballooned - from $44bn in 2020 to an eye-popping $112bn this year. "India's economic dependence on China continued to deepen while political, security, and investment ties were at their lowest point," Kevin Zongzhe Li, a Washington-based Fellow at the Asia Society Policy Institute's Centre for China Analysis, told the BBC. More worryingly, exports to China remained below pre-pandemic level even as imports doubled in this period. "China now supplies over 30% of India's industrial imports, and India depends on it for more than 100 critical products. And the imbalance is worsening," says Ajay Srivastava of the Delhi-based Global Trade and Research Initiative (GTRI). If the rapid pace of imports continues, bilateral deficit could jump to $134bn, giving Beijing even more leverage over Indian industry, according to Srivastava. On the sidelines of the Brics summit in Delhi in September, amid a deepening thaw between the Asian giants, Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Chinese President Xi Jinping vowed to address these "structural trade imbalances and supply chain issues". But given how deeply entrenched Chinese imports have become to India's industrial economy, this will be a formidable task for Delhi, experts told the BBC.

articles.title: Brazil election goes to run-off as right-wing Flávio Bolsonaro wins first round
articles.summary: With neither candidate getting more than 50% of the vote, the election will go to a run-off on 25 October.
articles.body_text: Right-wing Flávio Bolsonaro has won the first round of Brazil's presidential election, beating left-wing President Lula da Silva, but falling short of an outright majority. There will be a run-off between the two candidates on 25 October. Bolsonaro is the son of the former president Jair Bolsonaro, who is serving a 27-year prison sentence for masterminding a failed coup after losing the 2022 election. Sunday's vote was close, with President Lula polling slightly ahead during the campaign. With almost all of the votes counted, Bolsonaro has 47% to Lula's 45% of the vote. Bolsonaro's result exceeded expectations, meaning the second round now looks like his to lose, given some of the other candidates knocked out in the first round were right-wing alternatives. His Liberal Party (PL) also had the most governors, senators and federal deputies elected in the results so far, meaning the party is expected to have the most influence in Congress. The majority of Latin America has now elected right-wing presidents, aligned to the Trump administration, and the run-off will determine whether Brazil – Latin America's largest country and economy – will follow suit. Speaking to reporters at the White House, US President Donald Trump said he expected the election to be "very close", but that Bolsonaro has had a "very, very big victory" in the first round. After casting his ballot, Lula, 80, warned the choice was between democracy and "barbarism". Bolsonaro, 45, said he wanted to "free the Brazilian people". Lula and Bolsonaro are the two biggest names in Brazilian politics, on the left and right, and this campaign has polarised Brazil yet again: with themes of sovereignty, crime, the economy and corruption being top concerns for voters. Lula is more popular in Brazil's poorer northeast, among low-income voters, Catholics, and women.

En otros países de Sudamérica, el encuentro comenzará a las 8:45 p. m. en Argentina, Brasil, Chile, Paraguay y Uruguay. El escenario será el Nu Stadium de Miami, recinto con capacidad para más de 26.000 espectadores. Para los hinchas que quieran seguir el encuentro desde Perú, la transmisión estará a cargo de América TV. La señal también anunció que llevará los amistosos de la Bicolor durante esta fecha FIFA a través de sus plataformas. En consecuencia, el duelo ante Colombia podrá seguirse por televisión y mediante las opciones digitales habilitadas por América Multimedia. La Bicolor llegará al compromiso con la necesidad de cerrar la gira con una actuación positiva. Perú perdió 4-1 ante Estados Unidos, empató 1-1 frente a México y posteriormente cayó 2-0 contra Canadá. El encuentro ante Colombia será, por ello, el cuarto y último partido de esta serie de amistosos internacionales antes de los compromisos programados para noviembre. Colombia tampoco llega después de una victoria. El conjunto dirigido por Néstor Lorenzo empató 1-1 con México el 26 de septiembre y perdió 1-0 frente a Paraguay el 2 de octubre. La Federación Colombiana de Fútbol confirmó que el duelo contra Perú será el cierre de su participación en esta fecha FIFA, también como parte de su proceso de preparación para los próximos desafíos internacionales. Más allá del resultado, el amistoso tendrá especial importancia para el proceso de Mano Menezes. La selección peruana atraviesa una etapa de renovación y estos partidos permiten al comando técnico evaluar jugadores, probar variantes y encontrar una base para los siguientes desafíos. El duelo ante Colombia será además la última presentación de la Bicolor en esta fecha FIFA de septiembre-octubre. El partido también servirá como una nueva oportunidad para que Perú encuentre respuestas después de sus tres primeros encuentros de la gira. Colombia, por su parte, buscará cerrar su calendario con un triunfo después de sus resultados ante México y Paraguay. Con ambos equipos en procesos de preparación, el encuentro en Miami aparece como una prueba más dentro del camino hacia las próximas competiciones oficiales.

articles.summary: Miraflores: incendio en Malecón de la Reserva afecta geomallas
articles.body_text: Un incendio se reporta en el parque Domodossola, en Malecón de la Reserva, distrito de Miraflores. El siniestro ocurrió al promediar las 9 de la mañana. Al lugar llegaron 16 unidades del Cuerpo de los Bomberos del Perú para atender la emergencia que causa preocupación entre los asistentes a dicha zona. Mario Casaretto, gerente de Gestión del Riesgo de Desastres de la Municipalidad Metropolitana de Lima (MML), indicó que parte de las geomallas utilizadas para evitar desprendimiento de rocas y plantas, han sido afectadas. Las llamas están cerca al centro comercial Larcomar y exactamente a 70 metros el recientemente inaugurado teleférico de Miraflores. Según testigos del siniestro, un grupo de turistas que paseaba por la zona fueron llevados nuevamente a su hotel para no ser afectados por el humo. También, algunas personas que en ese momento se encontraban en el Colegio Médico del Perú para votar por las Elecciones Regionales y Municipales 2026, fueron cubiertas por cenizas. Personal de Serenazgo y la Policía Nacional del Perú (PNP), han cerrado esta vía en ambas direcciones. En tanto, los bomberos continúan realizando trabajos denodados para controlar el incendio y llegar hasta la zona donde se habría iniciado el fuego, sin embargo, el acceso al acantilado dificulta el acceso a las mangueras. Minutos más tarde de haberse producido el incendio, se reportó una persona herida. Canal N indicó que esta recibió atención en el lugar por parte de efectivos de la Policía Nacional del Perú (PNP), y personas que se encontraban en la zona. De acuerdo con información preliminar, se trataría aparentemente de una persona en situación de calle.

articles.body_text: El candidato a primer regidor de la Municipalidad de Lima por Renovación Popular, Rafael López Aliaga, defendió su postulación y la posibilidad que pueda asumir como nuevo burgomaestre en el próximo periodo. El dirigente político sostuvo que su inscripción respetó las normas vigentes en la legislación electoral y que, tal como está la norma, podría incluso volver a postular en el 2030. “De acuerdo a la ley, en este minuto, hoy día yo podría ir hasta un tercer periodo. No es mi intención, pero podría”, declaró el postulante en una entrevista con RPP este viernes. El aspirante edil explicó que dicha opción legal derivó de su postulación como teniente alcalde y no como alcalde titular. López Aliaga precisó que la prohibición de reelección inmediata se refiere de forma exclusiva al cargo de alcalde. El candidato recordó que el Jurado Nacional de Elecciones respaldó la validez de su lista partidaria de manera definitiva en fallos recientes. “El verbo que se debe aplicar acá es postular, no estoy postulando a alcalde, estoy postulando a teniente alcalde, y por ausencia del titular me toca asumir”, afirmó el aspirante. El dirigente reiteró que su candidatura cumplió con los requisitos legales establecidos para el proceso edil. López Aliaga señaló que la normativa vigente prevé la entrega de la credencial de alcalde al primer regidor en caso de victoria de su partido. El postulante indicó que asumirá la conducción de Lima si Renovación Popular logra el triunfo en las elecciones del 4 de octubre. “Mi opinión personal, te digo que un alcalde sí debería tener una reelección, una reelección inmediata para poder terminar. Cuatro años es muy poco”, expresó el líder político. El candidato argumentó que las gestiones municipales requieren mayor tiempo para la ejecución de obras de infraestructura en la capital. “Este miércoles voy a declarar como acusador a toda la mafia criminal de ONPE y voy a meterlos a la cárcel 20 años por haber robado la voluntad popular”, sostuvo el dirigente. El candidato denunció supuestas irregularidades cometidas por las autoridades electorales durante los comicios anteriores del 2026 cuando buscó ser presidente de la República. López Aliaga, en otro momento, cuestionó la imparcialidad del Jurado Nacional de Elecciones en la resolución de las tachas presentadas contra postulantes. Por esto, confirmó la presencia de personeros en todas las mesas de votación para la vigilancia del escrutinio en la capital.

El rendimiento del Treasury a 10 años cerró en 5,345% y el de 30 años en 5,697%, manteniéndose cerca de máximos de varias décadas. articles.body_text: El candidato a primer regidor de la Municipalidad de Lima por Renovación Popular, Rafael López Aliaga, defendió su postulación y la posibilidad que pueda asumir como nuevo burgomaestre en el próximo periodo. El dirigente político sostuvo que su inscripción respetó las normas vigentes en la legislación electoral y que, tal como está la norma, podría incluso volver a postular en el 2030. “De acuerdo a la ley, en este minuto, hoy día yo podría ir hasta un tercer periodo. No es mi intención, pero podría”, declaró el postulante en una entrevista con RPP este viernes. El aspirante edil explicó que dicha opción legal derivó de su postulación como teniente alcalde y no como alcalde titular. López Aliaga precisó que la prohibición de reelección inmediata se refiere de forma exclusiva al cargo de alcalde. El candidato recordó que el Jurado Nacional de Elecciones respaldó la validez de su lista partidaria de manera definitiva en fallos recientes. “El verbo que se debe aplicar acá es postular, no estoy postulando a alcalde, estoy postulando a teniente alcalde, y por ausencia del titular me toca asumir”, afirmó el aspirante. El dirigente reiteró que su candidatura cumplió con los requisitos legales establecidos para el proceso edil. López Aliaga señaló que la normativa vigente prevé la entrega de la credencial de alcalde al primer regidor en caso de victoria de su partido. El postulante indicó que asumirá la conducción de Lima si Renovación Popular logra el triunfo en las elecciones del 4 de octubre. “Mi opinión personal, te digo que un alcalde sí debería tener una reelección, una reelección inmediata para poder terminar. Cuatro años es muy poco”, expresó el líder político. El candidato argumentó que las gestiones municipales requieren mayor tiempo para la ejecución de obras de infraestructura en la capital. “Este miércoles voy a declarar como acusador a toda la mafia criminal de ONPE y voy a meterlos a la cárcel 20 años por haber robado la voluntad popular”, sostuvo el dirigente. El candidato denunció supuestas irregularidades cometidas por las autoridades electorales durante los comicios anteriores del 2026 cuando buscó ser presidente de la República. López Aliaga, en otro momento, cuestionó la imparcialidad del Jurado Nacional de Elecciones en la resolución de las tachas presentadas contra postulantes. Por esto, confirmó la presencia de personeros en todas las mesas de votación para la vigilancia del escrutinio en la capital.

articles.body_text: Flávio Bolsonaro llega a la segunda vuelta de las elecciones en Brasil con una estrecha ventaja sobre Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, pero el resultado del 25 de octubre aún está abierto. Los dos candidatos entran ahora en una nueva batalla por los apoyos de los sectores que quedaron fuera de la primera vuelta y por movilizar a los electores que no acudieron a las urnas, en un escenario donde cada voto puede resultar decisivo. Con el 100% de mesas escrutadas, el senador Flávio Bolsonaro, hijo del exmandatario Jair Bolsonaro, obtuvo el 47,03 % de los votos, casi dos puntos más que el presidente Lula (45,16 %). Bolsonaro no solo superó a Lula en porcentaje, sino que sus 56,1 millones de votos están por encima de los 49 millones que obtuvo su padre en las elecciones del 2018 y los 51 millones del 2022. Para imponerse en segunda vuelta, la principal fuente de nuevos votos para Bolsonaro son los candidatos menores de derecha, que concentraron cerca del 8% de las preferencias. Como todos tienen posiciones conservadoras, el candidato del Partido Liberal tiene margen para negociar su apoyo y consolidar el voto anti Lula o anti Partido de los Trabajadores (PT). Mientras que Lula tiene menos margen para sumar adherencias de candidatos derrotados. Entonces, su estrategia debería pasar por movilizar a los abstencionistas, el 21% del padrón, y captar votos blancos y nulos. Para Francesco Tucci, director de la Carrera de Comunicación y Periodismo en la Universidad Peruana de Ciencias Aplicadas (UPC), la ventaja de dos puntos de Flávio Bolsonaro es demasiado estrecha como para considerar que está definida la elección. El analista internacional sostiene que el resultado final dependerá principalmente de tres variables: la capacidad de los candidatos de movilizar a los abstencionistas, de captar los votos de quienes quedaron fuera de la contienda, y de evitar que parte del electorado opte por el voto blanco o nulo. Tucci considera especialmente relevante enfocarse en los más de 33 millones de electores que no acudieron a las urnas. “El candidato que sepa activar el voto abstencionista tendrá una ventaja importante”, indica. Precisa que no es posible asumir que quienes no votaron en la primera vuelta sean necesariamente electores contrarios a Lula o favorables a Bolsonaro. Más bien, manifiesta que una parte de ese electorado puede estar expresando su rechazo a la fuerte polarización política del país, sin identificarse plenamente con ninguna de las dos opciones. Sobre la transferencia de votos de los candidatos eliminados, Tucci remarca que estos no necesariamente pasarán automáticamente a Bolsonaro. Señala que hasta ahora solo uno de esos candidatos ha manifestado claramente su intención de movilizar a sus electores contra Lula: Romeu Zema, del Partido Novo. Otros han optado por mantener una posición neutral, por lo que Bolsonaro tendrá que negociar y convencer a esos sectores. Para el analista, también se debe considerar la fragmentación existente dentro de la propia derecha brasileña, entre sectores conservadores y de extrema derecha. Por ello, cree que la ventaja obtenida por Bolsonaro en la primera vuelta constituye un punto de partida favorable, pero no una garantía de transferencia automática de votos. El embajador Juan Álvarez Vita indica que Flávio Bolsonaro parte con una ventaja que, aunque estrecha, podría darle una posición favorable, por que en la actual coyuntura dos puntos es difícil de revertir. Coincide en que los electores de los otros candidatos no necesariamente tienen definido su apoyo automático para la segunda vuelta. Para Lula, una de las principales tareas será recuperar la participación en regiones donde históricamente el PT tiene una base electoral importante, especialmente en el noreste, precisa Tucci. El analista sostiene que existe margen para movilizar a electores que tradicionalmente apoyan al PT y que no acudieron a votar en la primera vuelta. Al mismo tiempo, el candidato izquierdista “tendrá que intentar atraer a sectores de centro y a votantes de partidos moderados que quedaron fuera de la segunda vuelta”. Tucci cree que una movilización intensa en el noreste, combinada con una captación significativa del voto moderado, podría modificar el escenario de cara al 25 de octubre. Con estas variables sobre la mesa, Tucci evita anticipar un ganador. “Mucho dependerá también de la fragmentación en el apoyo a Lula. Si la abstención continúa elevada y Bolsonaro no consigue una transferencia importante de los votos de los candidatos eliminados, su ventaja inicial podría reducirse. En sentido contrario, una movilización fuerte de Lula en el noreste y la incorporación de votantes de centro podrían modificar la relación de fuerzas. Es un voto extremadamente complejo y difícil de predecir”, resume Tucci. Álvarez Vita sostiene que el principal margen de crecimiento de Lula está en el 21% del electorado que no acudió a votar, además de quienes optaron por el voto blanco o nulo. Pero advierte que movilizar a ese sector será difícil. El embajador identifica además el aumento del costo de vida como uno de los principales puntos débiles de Lula de cara al balotaje. Según su lectura, el deterioro económico puede influir en aquellos electores que aún no tienen decidido su voto y convertirse en un factor que favorezca a la oposición. También intuye que precisamente en ese bolsón de abstencionistas podría haber un buen porcentaje de personas inconformes con la situación económica, pero que tampoco se sienten representadas por una opción como la de Flávio Bolsonaro. Tucci indica que la ausencia de Lula en los debates de la primera vuelta pudo responder a una estrategia para preservar su electorado ya consolidado. Según el analista, participar en un debate no necesariamente beneficia a un candidato: una actuación considerada negativa puede generar más costos que la decisión de no exponerse. Sostiene que la campaña habría optado por evitar una exposición que pudiera poner en riesgo el apoyo que ya tenía. Sin embargo, de cara al balotaje la dinámica será diferente. Con solo dos candidatos en carrera, cualquier exposición pública tendrá mayor peso y ambos deberán disputar un electorado más reducido y, al mismo tiempo, más decisivo, puntualiza. Álvarez Vita considera que el resultado de la primera vuelta pudo tomar por sorpresa a Lula y que, a partir de ahora, el presidente deberá asumir un papel mucho más activo en la campaña, incluyendo su participación en los debates. Indica que Lula habría afrontado la primera vuelta con un exceso de confianza, al considerar que tenía asegurada la victoria. Ahora, el resultado debería obligarlo a modificar su estrategia.

articles.body_text: Un incendio se reporta en el parque Domodossola, en Malecón de la Reserva, distrito de Miraflores. El siniestro ocurrió al promediar las 9 de la mañana. Al lugar llegaron 16 unidades del Cuerpo de los Bomberos del Perú para atender la emergencia que causa preocupación entre los asistentes a dicha zona. Mario Casaretto, gerente de Gestión del Riesgo de Desastres de la Municipalidad Metropolitana de Lima (MML), indicó que parte de las geomallas utilizadas para evitar desprendimiento de rocas y plantas, han sido afectadas. Las llamas están cerca al centro comercial Larcomar y exactamente a 70 metros el recientemente inaugurado teleférico de Miraflores. Según testigos del siniestro, un grupo de turistas que paseaba por la zona fueron llevados nuevamente a su hotel para no ser afectados por el humo. Personal de Serenazgo y la Policía Nacional del Perú (PNP), han cerrado esta vía en ambas direcciones. En tanto, los bomberos continúan realizando trabajos denodados para controlar el incendio y llegar hasta la zona donde se habría iniciado el fuego, sin embargo, el acceso al acantilado dificulta el acceso a las mangueras. Minutos más tarde de haberse producido el incendio, se reportó una persona herida. Canal N indicó que esta recibió atención en el lugar por parte de efectivos de la Policía Nacional del Perú (PNP), y personas que se encontraban en la zona. De acuerdo con información preliminar, se trataría aparentemente de una persona en situación de calle.

articles.body_text: El candidato a primer regidor de la Municipalidad de Lima por Renovación Popular, Rafael López Aliaga, defendió su postulación y la posibilidad que pueda asumir como nuevo burgomaestre en el próximo periodo. El dirigente político sostuvo que su inscripción respetó las normas vigentes en la legislación electoral y que, tal como está la norma, podría incluso volver a postular en el 2030. “De acuerdo a la ley, en este minuto, hoy día yo podría ir hasta un tercer periodo. No es mi intención, pero podría”, declaró el postulante en una entrevista con RPP este viernes. El aspirante edil explicó que dicha opción legal derivó de su postulación como teniente alcalde y no como alcalde titular. López Aliaga precisó que la prohibición de reelección inmediata se refiere de forma exclusiva al cargo de alcalde. El candidato recordó que el Jurado Nacional de Elecciones respaldó la validez de su lista partidaria de manera definitiva en fallos recientes. “El verbo que se debe aplicar acá es postular, no estoy postulando a alcalde, estoy postulando a teniente alcalde, y por ausencia del titular me toca asumir”, afirmó el aspirante. El dirigente reiteró que su candidatura cumplió con los requisitos legales establecidos para el proceso edil. López Aliaga señaló que la normativa vigente prevé la entrega de la credencial de alcalde al primer regidor en caso de victoria de su partido. El postulante indicó que asumirá la conducción de Lima si Renovación Popular logra el triunfo en las elecciones del 4 de octubre. “Mi opinión personal, te digo que un alcalde sí debería tener una reelección, una reelección inmediata para poder terminar. Cuatro años es muy poco”, expresó el líder político. El candidato argumentó que las gestiones municipales requieren mayor tiempo para la ejecución de obras de infraestructura en la capital. “Este miércoles voy a declarar como acusador a toda la mafia criminal de ONPE y voy a meterlos a la cárcel 20 años por haber robado la voluntad popular”, sostuvo el dirigente. El candidato denunció supuestas irregularidades cometidas por las autoridades electorales durante los comicios anteriores del 2026 cuando buscó ser presidente de la República. López Aliaga, en otro momento, cuestionó la imparcialidad del Jurado Nacional de Elecciones en la resolución de las tachas presentadas contra postulantes. Por esto, confirmó la presencia de personeros en todas las mesas de votación para la vigilancia del escrutinio en la capital.

articles.body_text: La plataforma de búsquedas de Google incorporó una nueva herramienta de personalización informativa que ya se encuentra disponible en distintos países y para todos los idiomas. Se trata de “Fuentes Preferidas”, una opción que permite a cada usuario decidir qué medios tendrán mayor presencia dentro del espacio dedicado a noticias relevantes. Con esta función, el sistema adapta los contenidos destacados según las preferencias seleccionadas por cada persona, otorgando mayor visibilidad a los portales elegidos durante las consultas realizadas en el buscador. Entre las alternativas disponibles, los usuarios pueden configurar a El Comercio como uno de sus medios prioritarios para acceder con mayor frecuencia a sus publicaciones informativas. A continuación, te contaremos todos los detalles que debes conocer sobre esta situación. La reciente herramienta implementada por Google busca que cada usuario tenga una experiencia informativa más personalizada, facilitando el acceso prioritario a los medios digitales que considera de mayor interés y credibilidad. En ese contexto, El Comercio se posiciona como una de las plataformas informativas que ofrece contenidos centrados en actualidad, análisis y cobertura periodística con enfoque riguroso, permitiendo a sus lectores mantenerse informados a través de su portal web. El primer paso consiste en ingresar al buscador de Google y realizar una consulta relacionada con un tema de actualidad o de interés informativo. articles.body_text: El Juzgado Penal de Investigación Preparatoria de Huaylas-Caraz dictó 18 meses de prisión preventiva contra dos investigados de nacionalidad venezolana por el asesinato de Susy Aponte Polo, conocida como China Polo. La resolución judicial incluye cargos por sicariato y lesiones graves contra cuatro ciudadanos que sufrieron disparos de arma de fuego durante el ataque. El Poder Judicial ordenó el internamiento penal de Luis Iván Obispo Díaz en calidad de autor directo del homicidio por encargo cometido en Huaylas. La Fiscalía le atribuye un pago de S/15,000 por ejecutar el disparo directo contra la postulante a la gobernación regional. La medida judicial comprendió además a Ronald José Toro Ardila como presunto financista y cómplice primario de la operación criminal. El Ministerio Público acreditó transferencias digitales desde su cuenta bancaria para pagar el hospedaje, los traslados y la compra del teléfono celular usado en el hecho. La Fiscalía sostuvo que ambos procesados carecen de arraigo domiciliario en el país y representan un peligro de fuga extremo. Las pericias balísticas, los testimonios presenciales y las inspecciones técnicas reforzaron los elementos de convicción aceptados por el juzgado. El juez dispuso el traslado de los imputados a un penal mientras continúan las diligencias de la investigación preparatoria. Las autoridades buscan determinar la identidad de los autores intelectuales que ordenaron el crimen de la candidata regional. El sicario atacó a disparos a China Polo el 19 de septiembre en las inmediaciones del mercado central de la ciudad de Caraz, en Áncash. La víctima realizaba una caminata proselitista junto a simpatizantes de su agrupación política cuando recibió el impacto directo en la cabeza. El atacante al usar su arma de fuego contra Aponte hirió a transeúntes y comensales en el lugar del suceso. Una mujer de 72 años perdió la vida doce días después debido a las graves heridas causadas por los proyectiles. Efectivos de la Policía Nacional capturaron a Obispo Díaz en la escena del crimen en posesión de una pistola tras un enfrentamiento armado. Las fuerzas del orden detuvieron posteriormente a Toro Ardila en Lima mediante un operativo de rastreo de sus cuentas bancarias.

articles.body_text: El candidato a primer regidor de la Municipalidad de Lima por Renovación Popular, Rafael López Aliaga, defendió su postulación y la posibilidad que pueda asumir como nuevo burgomaestre en el próximo periodo. El dirigente político sostuvo que su inscripción respetó las normas vigentes en la legislación electoral y que, tal como está la norma, podría incluso volver a postular en el 2030. “De acuerdo a la ley, en este minuto, hoy día yo podría ir hasta un tercer periodo. No es mi intención, pero podría”, declaró el postulante en una entrevista con RPP este viernes. El aspirante edil explicó que dicha opción legal derivó de su postulación como teniente alcalde y no como alcalde titular. López Aliaga precisó que la prohibición de reelección inmediata se refiere de forma exclusiva al cargo de alcalde. El candidato recordó que el Jurado Nacional de Elecciones respaldó la validez de su lista partidaria de manera definitiva en fallos recientes. “El verbo que se debe aplicar acá es postular, no estoy postulando a alcalde, estoy postulando a teniente alcalde, y por ausencia del titular me toca asumir”, afirmó el aspirante. El dirigente reiteró que su candidatura cumplió con los requisitos legales establecidos para el proceso edil. López Aliaga señaló que la normativa vigente prevé la entrega de la credencial de alcalde al primer regidor en caso de victoria de su partido. El postulante indicó que asumirá la conducción de Lima si Renovación Popular logra el triunfo en las elecciones del 4 de octubre. “Mi opinión personal, te digo que un alcalde sí debería tener una reelección, una reelección inmediata para poder terminar. Cuatro años es muy poco”, expresó el líder político. El candidato argumentó que las gestiones municipales requieren mayor tiempo para la ejecución de obras de infraestructura en la capital. “Este miércoles voy a declarar como acusador a toda la mafia criminal de ONPE y voy a meterlos a la cárcel 20 años por haber robado la voluntad popular”, sostuvo el dirigente. El candidato denunció supuestas irregularidades cometidas por las autoridades electorales durante los comicios anteriores del 2026 cuando buscó ser presidente de la República. López Aliaga, en otro momento, cuestionó la imparcialidad del Jurado Nacional de Elecciones en la resolución de las tachas presentadas contra postulantes. Por esto, confirmó la presencia de personeros en todas las mesas de votación para la vigilancia del escrutinio en la capital.

articles.title: Lucid Motors' EV output falls to lowest level in almost 2 years | TechCrunch
articles.summary: The company is deliberately limiting production after years of struggling to find mass-market demand for its EVs.
articles.body_text: Lucid Motors built 2,954 electric vehicles (EVs) in the third quarter of this year, a 54% drop from a year ago, as the company purposely limits production to better meet demand for its EVs. This was the third straight quarter in which the number of EVs Lucid built has declined. It’s also the lowest quarterly output since the first quarter of 2025, which was just after Lucid Motors started production of its second EV, the Gravity SUV . Lucid delivered 3,806 EVs in the third quarter, roughly flat with the second quarter and down about 200 vehicles from the third quarter of 2025. The company has struggled to find buyers for either of its first two luxury EVs. In five of the last six quarters, it built more vehicles than it delivered. Lucid’s new CEO, Silvio Napoli, has spent the last few months leading an effort to “simplify the company.” That effort has included laying off around 1,500 employees, streamlining the company’s leadership, and eliminating a second shift at its factory in Arizona in a bid to reach cost savings of $1.4 billion . Lucid also delayed the release of its third EV , the Cosmos. That model is supposed to be much cheaper, starting at under $50,000. The third-quarter figures, released Monday afternoon, come just a few days after rival EV upstart Rivian posted its best quarter in history on the back of the R2, its new, more affordable SUV . Although Rivian didn’t break out specific delivery figures for the R2, the company shipped nearly 20,000 vehicles in the third quarter , the first full quarter with the R2 in production, up from 12,194 in the second quarter . Lucid’s failure to find a large market of buyers for its EVs is even more stark when compared with the promises the company made when it went public in 2021. That year, Lucid Motors merged with a special purpose acquisition company and estimated it would ship as many as 90,000 EVs in 2024 alone . The company raised $4 billion in the transaction. On Lucid’s second-quarter earnings call in August, Napoli spoke about why he thinks the company has failed to make a dent in the EV market. “While there is no question that Lucid brought leading innovations and outstanding products to the market, we have disappointed on several fronts, and for far too long,” he said. “We have not executed consistently. We missed commitments, launched products before they were ready, underinvested in service, responded too slowly to quality issues, and allowed complexity to slow decisions down.” The Cosmos’ lower price could, in theory, let Lucid access a wider market, but Napoli cautioned shareholders that rushing the new EV out could create more trouble. “We will not repeat the mistakes of the past by bringing a product to market before it is ready,” Napoli said on the call. articles.title: OpenAI will start watermarking ChatGPT's text in the EU | TechCrunch
articles.summary: OpenAI will watermark ChatGPT and Codex text in the EU to comply with the AI Act. Editing can make the invisible marks harder to detect, it says.
articles.body_text: OpenAI will start adding an invisible watermark to text generated by ChatGPT and Codex in the European Union to comply with the EU AI Act, the company said Monday in a blog post . The EU AI Act’s transparency rules , which took effect on August 2, require AI companies to mark AI-generated content in a way other systems can identify. OpenAI said the watermark will roll out over the coming weeks to eligible ChatGPT and Codex users on all plans, but only in the EU. Developers using OpenAI’s API anywhere in the world can turn it on for select models starting today; it’s off by default. OpenAI said it is not making text watermarking a global default at launch. The watermark is not an actual symbol, but works by subtly shaping the model’s word choices, leaving a pattern readers can’t see, but a detector can pick up. Because it lives in the words themselves, it travels with the text when it’s copied and pasted. OpenAI said the watermark doesn’t identify the user, and that it saw no meaningful change in its models’ performance with it switched on. OpenAI also published a technical report for its method, called textGrain, alongside the announcement. Co-written with researchers from the University of Pennsylvania and Yale, it walks through an example of using a secret key to sort next-word predictions to finish the sentence. Add hundreds of these nudges together, and the detector can spot AI-generated content using only the text and the key. Can the watermark be removed by editing? OpenAI’s tests suggest yes. In one test, replacing 10% of words with synonyms dropped detection from about 92% to 66%. The company also said short passages, math answers, and translated text are harder to detect. “These limitations contribute to our decision to provide initial detector access only to approved researchers and expert organizations, who can help us evaluate reliability and responsible uses,” said the company. OpenAI also cautioned that a missing watermark “does not prove human authorship.” The text could be too short or too heavily edited, or it could come from another company’s AI. “[Watermarks] can indicate that an OpenAI system generated or processed part of a passage, but not how much human judgment, editing, or creativity went into it,” the company said. The announcement comes two months after Anthropic said it would watermark text generated by Claude, a move it’s applying worldwide. That decision drew backlash from some Claude users , who argued they had supplied “the instructions, context, decisions” while Claude was just “the tool.” OpenAI had built a text watermark before but held off on releasing it, partly over concerns that users would switch to rivals that didn’t watermark, The Wall Street Journal reported in 2024. Anthropic, Google, Meta, Microsoft, and OpenAI are among the companies that have committed to following the EU’s code of practice on AI-generated content.

articles.title: Etched fields funding offers at $40B+ valuation, sources say | TechCrunch
articles.summary: Just a couple of months after its last big raise, the AI chip startup is already being plied with investment offers at double or more its current value, sources tell TechCrunch.
articles.body_text: Although it’s only been a couple of months since Etched raised $700 million at a $21 billion valuation , the AI chip startup is already being plied with investment offers at double or more its value, according to people familiar with the company. Etched is reviewing incoming bids that range from $40 billion from top-tier investors to $50 billion from lesser-known backers, one person said. These fundraising talks are early, so terms of any deal, should one happen, may change. Etched declined to comment. While this may seem like a fast timetable to raise another mega round, Etched is pursuing a particularly expensive segment of the AI industry: building full AI hardware systems powered by its own proprietary chips. The person familiar with these offers said that if it raises as much as its last round, this could give Etched a cushion of as much as 3.5 years of runway. There are reasons why VCs are hot to own a piece of Etched. The four-year-old startup shows promise of challenging Nvidia. Not only did quant trading firm Jane Street lead the last $700 million round, it is also a customer that took delivery of an early system. Etched said in July that it had already secured $1 billion in customer orders, including the one from Jane Street, after manufacturing its test chip at a TSMC factory this summer. Co-founder and COO Robert Wachen previously told TechCrunch that investors are so enthusiastic because Etched has designed two new components from scratch to speed up inference — the computing process that happens after a user submits a prompt. The company claims its chips can process more tokens faster and at a lower cost than Nvidia’s. That’s the reason its processors have been so attractive to Jane Street, for whom a microscopic advantage in speed can yield massive profits. The startup has also impressed investors with its ability to attract engineers from Nvidia, with roughly 15% of Etched’s 400-person workforce having previously worked at the chip giant, according to The Wall Street Journal. Etched also operates a new 10-megawatt data center in Silicon Valley and established a facility in Taiwan to coordinate production near TSMC. Co-founders Gavin Uberti and Chris Zhu famously met in an advanced math course at Harvard, while Wachen was Uberti’s roommate and they dropped out to pursue the company. In terms of fast rounds at big leaps in valuations, Etched already has a history of them. The startup announced a $300 million round at a $10.3 billion valuation led by Sequoia in July. It announced the $700 million round at a $21 billion valuation in September. Back-to-back funding rounds, which essentially act as a single financing split into two tranches with separate valuations, are increasingly common among the buzziest startups.
